notes:
Send email from your own mailbox. If you are HR, an admin, the CEO or the MD, every email you send from HRMS — offer and appointment letters, payslips, interview invites, document requests — has always left from the company's mailbox with your name on it. Now you can connect your own Google account under Profile → Settings → Sending email, and from then on those emails leave from your own address, sit in your Sent folder, and replies come straight to you. Google opens in your browser, asks for permission to send email on your behalf (the only permission taken — HRMS can never read your inbox) and brings you back to the app. Before you send anything, the compose screen says which mailbox it will leave from. Disconnect at any time; and if Google ever stops accepting the connection, your emails simply go out from the company mailbox until you reconnect — nothing is ever lost.

Sunday and comp-off duty now shows who decided. On the Admin rest-day list and on My Team, each claim carries who approved, rejected or changed it and when, with a history you can unfold wherever a decision was changed. A Super Admin's decision reads as "the Backend".

Questions inside course videos behave better: "Not now" puts a question aside with the video paused and it comes back when you press play, instead of popping straight back up. The in-app guide is updated to match.

For everybody else nothing changes.
